dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Alright, I'm in good spirits. Is there anything you wish to know?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I want to hear some of your knowledge!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: I am indisputably an erudite scholar, for my learning encompasses the stars above and earth below.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: ...But it would consume a considerable amount of time to explain the tenets of astrology...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: For now, some practical advice will do!

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Hmm... For instance, ingredients approaching their expiration date can be used to create very cost-effective meals as long as you thoroughly cook them with the appropriate cooking methods.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Many stores have monthly sales. Find an opportune time to stock up on grains and dried foods. As staple foods, they will keep you feeling full for a long time.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Also... Processing your own meat products is much cheaper than buying them ready-made.

choices.text: Your knowledge is all about saving money...

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: How impolite of you to generalize it as such!

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: These techniques are all a crucial element of living a disciplined life. They are the result of refinement of the objective laws of the world.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: S—So I'll be stricter with you. You need to be more disciplined if you are to understand this world's truths!

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Heh, you will understand how useful these are once you try.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: After you have mastered these, I will impart more of the secret wonders hidden deep within this world.

choices.text: You seem to have a lot of life experience...
